public_rationale: Futurism's 30 December 2024 report preserves estimates for the 20 December preview: high-compute o3 used well over $1,000 in computing expense per ARC-AGI task, compared with roughly $5 paid to human solvers [e1]. These estimates support the claim's contextual comparison of high-compute o3 with paid humans on this benchmark [e1].
limitations: The retained report was published after Marcus's 21 December statement; it describes the earlier preview estimates [e1].
These are reported estimates, not verified internal OpenAI costs or retail prices; human compensation and machine inference expense are different accounting measures [e1].
The comparison does not establish typical o3 costs, costs across ordinary human work, or costs for a representative human population [e1].
The reported figures do not establish the surrounding passage's thousandfold cost comparison [e1].
